Yes. I found several Toronto-area options that look much more suitable for a nail salon that wants polished Reels without committing to a $3k–$8k/month agency retainer.

Best fits

Inna Malovichko Videographer — Etobicoke

Particularly interesting for a nail salon because she explicitly works with beauty professionals and short-form content.

Focuses on Instagram Reels/TikTok/Shorts and can shoot on location.

I’d put this near the top of your outreach list if you want someone who understands beauty content rather than generic corporate video.

Animalz Media — Downtown Toronto

Social-first video production geared toward small businesses, including Reels/TikTok.

More production-oriented than a traditional social-media agency, so you can potentially buy a defined shoot/edit package rather than a big marketing retainer.

Shortents — Downtown Toronto

Specifically offers UGC, TikTok/short-form vertical content and local-business content.

Their positioning around efficient production for small businesses makes them worth getting a quote from.

The Socials Labs — Downtown Toronto

Boutique rather than a huge agency.

Offers on-location content shoots and hands-on social-content guidance, including behind-the-scenes video.

Pasky Studio — Kensington/Baldwin Village

This is a different approach: rent the studio and bring in a creator/videographer, rather than paying an agency.

Published studio bundles start at $310 for 6 hours, while its creator package is $126 for 2 hours and its full-production option is $351 for 2 hours. 
PASKY MEDIA

Potentially excellent if you want to batch-shoot 15–30 nail clips in one afternoon.

Especially budget-friendly published packages

The Toronto Content Lab is one of the strongest price/value options I found. Their published plans are:

$399/month — 60-minute session + up to 8 pieces of content

$499/month — adds trend research and scripting

$599/month — scripting, filming, editing and posting

Three-month commitment. 
The Toronto Content Lab

Over Here Toronto is good if you don't want a monthly commitment:

$750 — 1 edited video

$950+ — 3 edited videos

$1,550+ — 8 edited videos

Their edited videos are formatted as Reels, with filming and usage rights included. 
Over Here Toronto

She's The Niche has a particularly relevant beauty/branding-content setup:

Content day from $650, including up to 6 hours of photo/video capture.

Edited Reels can be added at $10/reel.

A $950+ option includes 30 pre-edited pieces optimized for Instagram. 
She's The Niche

What I'd choose for a nail salon

I'd prioritize Inna Malovichko, The Toronto Content Lab, and She's The Niche.

For a salon, I wouldn't necessarily pay for 20–30 Reels every month. A smarter setup could be one 2–3 hour batch shoot every 4–6 weeks, capturing:

nail transformations / before & afters

close-up polish/application shots

technician POV

satisfying filing/buffing clips

trending audio formats

"3 nail trends for fall" talking-head clips

client reaction/reveal

salon ambience

staff personality/BTS

booking CTA videos

That gives you a large library while avoiding the traditional agency-retainer model. For comparison, Origin Films' Toronto package starts at $2,997/month for 20 Reels, which is exactly the kind of retainer I'd avoid for a smaller salon. 
Origin Films

My target budget: roughly $500–$1,000 per content shoot, rather than a $2k+ monthly retainer.

If you tell me your approximate monthly budget (e.g. $500, $1,000, or $1,500), I can narrow this to 5 Toronto providers and compare their prices, beauty/salon experience, deliverables, and contact links.
